component.name: escribo
component.summary: Annotate screenshots with arrows, boxes, highlights and text

description.p: escribo is a lightweight annotation tool for screenshots. Add arrows, boxes, a highlighter, text labels and emoji; scramble anything that should not be readable; crop, pad and frame the shot; then copy it or save it.
It stays in the tray and opens a window by itself when a new screenshot lands in Pictures/Screenshots. Everything runs locally.
